function: Minor fibrillar collagen. Component of cartilage collage fibrils. Interacts with COL2A1 and COL11A. Important for cartilage and intervertebral disc integrity.
pathways: ECM organization; collagen fibril organization; skeletal system development
pain_relevance: Mutations cause multiple epiphyseal dysplasia (MED) and Stickler syndrome. Joint pain is a core symptom. COL9A1 knockout mice show osteoarthritis.

function: Lipid-binding protein of the BPI family. Lipid transfer/lipopolysaccharide binding. Expressed in epithelial cells (oral, nasopharyngeal) and testis.
pathways: lipid metabolic process; innate immune response; defense response to bacterium
pain_relevance: Indirect. BPI family proteins modulate LPS response. Chronic LPS exposure induces pain sensitization. BPIFB2 in saliva was proposed as biomarker for Sjögren syndrome.
immune_connection: Yes — BPI family = bactericidal permeability-increasing proteins. Innate immunity.

function: Secreted growth factor/cytokine. Binds heparan sulfate. Promotes neurite outgrowth, angiogenesis, and tissue repair. Mitogenic for fibroblasts. Involved in bone formation and osteogenesis.
pathways: neuron development; angiogenesis; osteoblast differentiation; FGFR signaling; ALK signaling
pain_relevance: Pleiotrophin is a ligand of ALK (anaplastic lymphoma kinase). PTN promotes neurite outgrowth — direct role in nerve repair. Upregulated in inflammatory pain models. Osteogenic factor — bone pain.
immune_connection: Adjacent. PTN modulates macrophage activation and inflammatory cytokine production.

function: Sialyltransferase. Adds sialic acid to glycoproteins and glycolipids. Key for cell surface sialylation. Regulates immune cell trafficking and T cell apoptosis.
pathways: glycosphingolipid biosynthesis; N-glycan biosynthesis; T cell receptor signaling
pain_relevance: Indirect. ST3GAL1 sialylation of T cells regulates TCR signaling. T cell activation = pain modulation. Also sialylates BDNF — neurotrophin involved in pain sensitization.
immune_connection: Yes — T cell sialylation, TCR signaling, immune cell trafficking.
